reviewed_by: Codex focused review for Core page responsiveness under MCP chat preparation
reason: Sixteen collected Python cases cover schema reuse, nested edits, invalid schemas, concurrent first-use validation, five blocking preparation phases, setup-status loop liveness, ranking overlap and cancellation, normal chat completion and streaming, viewer detach, turn cancellation, subagent continuation, and unchanged MCP identity and approval behavior. An isolated production UI on a disposable LAN Core also exercises concurrent synthetic chats and page reloads.
exclusions: No frontend or native source changed. Browser selectors do not exercise server-side cold MCP validation, so Playwright selection is empty; a paired desktop Chromium browser and direct page timing against an isolated real Core cover the operator journey. Unrelated Python suites and physical-device testing are excluded.
